title: ParCa cache bundle contents (out/cache-showcase)
interpretation: The four cache-bundle artifacts all present: initial_state.json (10.39 MB), sim_data_cache.dill (164.92 MB), metadata.json (210 B), cache_version.json (1.1 KB). initial_state has 16321 bulk molecule species + 11 unique molecule types across 4 top-level stores (bulk/unique/environment/boundary). All four are required for showcase-2 to resume. NB: the cache_version artifact ships as cache_version.json (not a dotfile .cache_version).
